question: You said that Reinhard drains away all the mana, but what would happen if he were to get close to, or touch, a magic machine? It’s no laughing matter if a magic machine were to be destroyed, and for those who depend on magic machines, being unable to use them would be inconvenient.
answer: Magic devices are basically not a part of life, so it’s no problem. There’s no worries about causing a problem at a level that would make everyday life inconvenient. Frankly, it’s taking away the mana that a magic device works with, so it’s alright to think of it like an appliance that doesn’t have enough electricity to run. A magic device that Reinhard touches, is just an appliance with the power turned off. A blunt instrument, in other words. Reinhard can fight fine, even with a powerless appliance, so don’t worry.
